ai.seo_question: What does 'Dhul-Arsh Al-Majid' mean in Islamic theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Dhul-Arsh' (Possessor of the Throne) underscores Allah's absolute dominion, where the Throne symbolizes the locus of divine command and the highest level of creation. This title is often linked with the concept of *Al-Majid* (The Glorious), highlighting the intersection of majesty and generosity in divine governance. The phrase serves as a reminder of God's transcendence above the physical constraints of the universe He created.
